doc: Read a cloud of particles in flight — where each is, what it is made of, how hot — and what struck the world, find those near a place, emit more, step it, return to a frame, and ask what would be.

tools.name: particles.observe
tools.description: The frame, the cloud's fingerprint, how many are in flight (by material), what struck the world in the last step (fastest first) and how many things matter's laws did

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: strikes are left out from the slowest, and `more` says how many

tools.name: particles.list
tools.description: Particles in the order emitted: id, material, place, velocity, age, life left and temperature in kelvin

first.description: from this place in the order (0 when none is given)

most.description: at most this many (64 when none is given; 1024 at most)

tools.name: particles.near
tools.description: The particles within a distance of a place, the nearest first, as particles.list gives them

most.description: at most this many (64 when none is given; 1024 at most)

tools.name: particles.emit
tools.description: Particles of a material emitted on the next step: at a place, at a speed — `count` of them, their speeds spread by up to `spread` m/s each way, the same spread every run
tools.undo: particles.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the cloud: they are emitted on the next step

velocity.description: [x, y, z] in m/s ([0, 0, 0] when none is given)

material.description: a material of the world's definition (particles.observe's `materials` lists those in flight)

kelvin.description: how hot (the material's own start when none is given)

size.description: m across (0.02 when none is given)

count.description: how many (1 when none is given; 4096 at most)

spread.description: m/s each way added to each one's velocity (0 when none is given)

tools.name: particles.step
tools.description: Steps the cloud: flight, the world's surfaces met, one tick of matter's laws
tools.undo: particles.seek to the frame it began at

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: particles.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept, bit for bit (a copy of the cloud and the emissions since, played again); what is stepped from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the cloud: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the cloud at the frame returned to

tools.name: particles.branch
tools.description: What would be: the cloud some steps ahead, particles emitted first if `at` and `material` are given (as particles.emit takes them), observed as particles.observe does; the cloud itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

tasks.name: see-what-is-in-flight
tasks.summary: Read the cloud, then the first particles and those near the middle

tasks.name: throw-sparks
tasks.summary: Emit hot iron sparks, step a second, and read what struck the world and how hot they are now

tasks.name: ask-before-emitting
tasks.summary: See what an emission would do a second ahead, the cloud itself untouched
